change: Per-repository warm Cell pool (v2/driver-cell/src/warmPool.ts + poolWorker.ts, wired in CellDriver.start and daemon config). Defaulted OFF (cells.warmPoolFree=0); enable via config cells.warmPoolFree or env HIVE_CELL_WARMPOOL_FREE.
hypothesis: Provisioning (git clone --local + checkout of the working tree) is the largest common Honeybee-owned boot segment (docs/performance/2026-09-21-boot-attribution.json). Pre-provisioning members off the event loop and claiming one by an atomic rename (+ checkout delta) removes that segment from the spawn critical path for every harness.
acceptance: Predeclared: a warm-pool claim <= 0.5x a cold provision at a realistic file count (3900), with no regression to cell.accept and no regression to cell.ready/usable on the standard 200-file cell-spawn suite. Met on both hosts.

microbench.note: cold = git clone --local + checkout on the spawn path; claim = git status dirty-guard + atomic rename + ledger rewrite (exact sha, no delta). Member build is off-path and untimed. Absolute cold numbers here use a hot page cache and a synthetic tree, so they are LOWER than the cold-origin production checkout (~985 ms on netcup, 2026-09-21-boot-attribution.json); the pool's win is largest exactly in that cold-cache case, which it avoids entirely.

netcup1_idle_ext4.claim_cost_note: the ~42ms claim is the single `git status --porcelain` dirty guard on 3900 files

endToEnd_BAAB.tool: scripts/perf/run.mjs --suite cell-spawn --cache warm --width 1 --sandbox on --tick-ms 200 --samples 6, HIVE_CELL_WARMPOOL_FREE toggled
endToEnd_BAAB.host: Mac Studio (workstation, CoW git-images), loaded (load ~7.0-7.5); 200-file fixture understates the win vs a real repo
endToEnd_BAAB.result: cell.ready p50 -50.5% (301 ms -> 149 ms), cell.usable p50 -27.7% (495 ms -> 358 ms), cell.accept unchanged (RPC path untouched). B1~B2 within 0.2% and A1~A2 identical: stable.

safety.default: off — no behaviour change on satellites/production until cells.warmPoolFree is set (needs a deploy, not done here).
safety.invariants_unit_tested: v2/driver-cell/tests/warmPool.test.ts: exact-sha claim + reap; provisionCell replays after a claim (ledger idempotency survives the pool); checkout delta to a reachable older sha; unreachable sha discarded not served; dirty member never handed out; two concurrent claims cannot take the same member (atomic rename); maxSize honoured; reapPool drops stale sha; empty pool -> cold fallback. Config parse/env/validation in v2/daemon/tests/config.test.ts.
safety.hot_lane: top-up runs in a worker_threads worker (poolWorker.ts), single-flight per repoKey, off the RPC accept and tick loop.

gaps.satellite_end_to_end: The full daemon end-to-end on a satellite (netcup-1/metal-1) needs the change live there, which requires `hive deploy` — deliberately NOT done this session. The satellite microbench (netcup-1, above) exercises the real provisioning+pool code on ext4 from a source copy; the daemon integration is proven on the Studio suite and unit tests.
gaps.workstation_cow: On workstations the cold path already uses CoW git-images; the pool still helps (it also removes the provision-worker spawn and the checkout), shown by the Studio B/A/A/B.
